ops.text: ccx vcs ship can die mid-colocation-sync on a concurrent lane's stale .git/index.lock: the jj bookmark moves, then 'Failed to reset Git HEAD state' aborts before push, leaving bookmark-rolled-back-but-commit-cut state that needs manual jj bookmark move + push. Hit 2026-07-19 in claude-pool with many agent lanes sharing the working copy. Ship could retry the HEAD reset briefly (git's lock is usually transient) or detect-and-remove a stale lock (no live git pid) before giving up.
